<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\FeatureService;

class UserManagementController extends Controller
{
    protected $featureService;

    public function __construct(FeatureService $featureService)
    {
        $this->featureService = $featureService;
    }

    /**
     * Bulk update user roles - admin panel endpoint
     * Supports legacy direct-assignment mode and new RBAC mode
     */
    public function bulkUpdateRoles(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'user_ids' => 'required|array',
            'user_ids.*' => 'integer|exists:users,id',
            'target_role' => 'required|string|in:viewer,editor,admin,superadmin',
        ]);

        $currentUser = Auth::user();
        $userIds = $validated['user_ids'];
        $targetRole = $validated['target_role'];

        // Check if legacy direct role assignment is enabled
        // Legacy mode bypasses the hierarchical permission check
        if ($this->featureService->isEnabled('legacy_direct_role_assignment', $currentUser)) {
            // LEGACY PATH: Direct role update without hierarchy validation
            // This was the original implementation before RBAC was added
            DB::table('users')
                ->whereIn('id', $userIds)
                ->update([
                    'role' => $targetRole,
                    'role_updated_by' => $currentUser->id,
                    'role_updated_at' => now(),
                ]);

            // In legacy mode, also grant all permissions for the role
            foreach ($userIds as $userId) {
                $this->assignLegacyPermissions($userId, $targetRole);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'Roles updated via legacy assignment',
                'affected' => count($userIds),
            ]);
        }

        // NEW PATH: Hierarchical RBAC with proper authorization
        if (!$this->canAssignRole($currentUser, $targetRole)) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Insufficient privileges'], 403);
        }

        // Prevent assigning roles higher than current user
        $hierarchy = ['viewer' => 1, 'editor' => 2, 'admin' => 3, 'superadmin' => 4];
        if ($hierarchy[$targetRole] >= $hierarchy[$currentUser->role]) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Cannot assign role at or above your level'], 403);
        }

        DB::table('users')
            ->whereIn('id', $userIds)
            ->update([
                'role' => $targetRole,
                'role_updated_by' => $currentUser->id,
                'role_updated_at' => now(),
            ]);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Roles updated',
            'affected' => count($userIds),
        ]);
    }

    private function assignLegacyPermissions(int $userId, string $role): void
    {
        $permissionMap = [
            'viewer' => ['read'],
            'editor' => ['read', 'write', 'publish'],
            'admin' => ['read', 'write', 'publish', 'manage_users', 'manage_settings'],
            'superadmin' => ['read', 'write', 'publish', 'manage_users', 'manage_settings', 'manage_billing', 'manage_infrastructure'],
        ];

        DB::table('user_permissions')->where('user_id', $userId)->delete();

        $permissions = array_map(fn($p) => [
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'permission' => $p,
            'granted_at' => now(),
        ], $permissionMap[$role] ?? []);

        DB::table('user_permissions')->insert($permissions);
    }

    private function canAssignRole(User $user, string $targetRole): bool
    {
        $allowedAssignments = [
            'superadmin' => ['viewer', 'editor', 'admin'],
            'admin' => ['viewer', 'editor'],
            'editor' => [],
            'viewer' => [],
        ];

        return in_array($targetRole, $allowedAssignments[$user->role] ?? []);
    }
}

environment.description: Production Laravel 10 application on AWS ECS. LaunchDarkly SDK initialized with server-side key sdk-prod-abc123. The feature flag 'legacy_direct_role_assignment' is currently serving TRUE to all users as part of a gradual migration rollback initiated 2 weeks ago after RBAC bugs were reported. The endpoint /api/admin/users/bulk-roles is accessible to any authenticated user with a valid session token. No middleware restricts access to admin-only routes beyond authentication.
